title: The Pullman conservatory's stone podium and the lodge's spirelet
items: Pullman's conservatory on 18th Street now stands on a dressed stone podium, as the 1894 plate and Lowe's photograph show it: pale piers at its corners, darker banded stone between them, and a moulded course under the glass.
The gardener's lodge beside it gains the slender slated spirelet the plate draws on its west roof.
